name: Hikikomori Muke Hitozuma-sensei
original_name: ひきこもり向け人妻せんせい
source:
My mother passed away half a year ago. I am a university student and currently live alone at an apartment. After her death, I decided not to go to university, so-called NEET. I seldom go out and just play games all day. But one day, when I go to university for a change, I see a female teacher masturbating...

[From ErogeShop]
